chunks: Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام:
That Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام executed a man for a woman whom he had killed deliberately, and he executed a woman who had killed a man intentionally.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام in this report
key_terms.امْرَأَةً: a woman, as one party in the homicide ruling
key_terms.رَجُلًا: a man, as one party in the homicide ruling
key_terms.قَتَلَ: executed or killed in legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on qisas between a man and a woman in cases of intentional murder?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial ruling of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning intentional homicide between men and women. It indicates the application of qisas in cases of deliberate murder regardless of whether the victim was male or female.
